author: Zephyr II
title: PPO‑Clip — 4‑step LN‑ConvLSTM(80) — heavy compute control
abstract: Increase 4‑step ConvLSTM width to 80 to reduce update throughput under PPO and test symmetry with PG results. Fixed PPO config: clip=0.2, value_clip=0.2, entropy=0.01, lr=4e‑4; grad‑clip=1.0.
